declarations.description:
Shows a secret the app already has, such as an API key, a webhook signing secret or a recovery code, the way the
Stripe and OpenAI key pages do: masked by default, with a button to show it, a button to copy it and, with
`regenerable`, a button to ask for a new one. It is a read-only display, not an input; use `c2-password-field` for
a secret the user types.

Masked, it keeps `reveal-start` leading and `reveal-end` trailing characters (`acme_live_••••••••••••4242`) and
draws the rest as a fixed number of bullets, so the mask does not tell the length. The visible ends never exceed
half of the secret: past that it is masked entirely. A screen reader hears "Starts with acme_live_, hidden, ends with
4242" rather than the bullets. Copy always copies the whole value, shown or not, and announces "Copied"; the
`copied` event it fires carries no detail, so the secret never travels with an event.
Regenerate only fires `regenerate`: the app confirms (a `c2-confirm-dialog` fits), fetches the new secret and sets
`value`, typically with `revealed` so the new key is shown once.

The buttons are a `c2-icon-button` toggle and a `c2-copy-button`; the `--c2-secret-field__action--*` variables
style all of them together. The built-in labels are English and translatable.
declarations.name: SecretField

cssProperties.description: Space between the label, the field and the help text.
cssProperties.name: --c2-secret-field--gap

cssProperties.description: Width of the host, a block by default.
cssProperties.name: --c2-secret-field--width

cssProperties.description: Width and height of each button.
cssProperties.name: --c2-secret-field__action--size

cssProperties.description: Show button while the secret is shown.
cssProperties.name: --c2-secret-field__action__selected--background-color

cssParts.description: The box holding the value and the buttons.
cssParts.name: field

cssParts.description: The bullets standing for the hidden part.
cssParts.name: mask

cssParts.description: Container of the `help` slot; hidden while it is empty.
cssParts.name: help

slots.description: Label above the field. Falls back to the `label` attribute.
slots.name: label

slots.description: Text under the field, such as "You won't be able to see this key again."
slots.name: help

members.name: value
members.description: The secret. Copy always copies all of it.

members.name: label
members.description: Label when the `label` slot is empty. Names the field for assistive technology.

members.name: revealed
members.description: Shows the whole secret instead of the mask. The show button toggles it.

members.name: revealStart
members.description: Leading characters left visible in the mask, e.g. `10` for an `acme_live_` prefix.

members.name: revealEnd
members.description: Trailing characters left visible in the mask.

members.name: regenerable
members.description: Adds a regenerate button, which fires `regenerate`.

members.name: hideReveal
members.description: Leaves out the show button, for a secret that should only ever be copied.

members.name: maskEnds
members.description:
The leading and trailing characters a mask keeps. None when they would show more than half of the secret: a mask
that leaves one character hidden hides nothing.

members.name: spokenMask
members.description: What a screen reader hears for the masked secret, in the page's language.

members.name: handleCopyEvent
members.description: Keeps the copy button's event, which carries the copied text, inside the field; the field's own has no detail.

events.name: reveal-change
events.description: The user showed or hid the secret; read `revealed`.

events.name: regenerate
events.description: The user asked for a new secret. Confirm it, then set `value`.
The secret was copied. It has no detail: the secret does not travel with the event.
events.name: copied
